items.html: Behold, the first man had no share at all of this world, which is the world of Assiyah. However, his body was from the world of Yetzirah; his Nefesh from the world of Beriah; his Ruach from the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut; his Neshama from the ZA of Atzilut; and his soul within soul [Neshama le-Neshama] from Aba and Ima of Atzilut.
